taxonomy.plot_digitization: Our extraction from plotted figure coordinates; not original raw arrays.
taxonomy.independent_reimplementation: Our separately written implementation; independence scoped to shared inputs.

taxonomy.official_dependency_run: Execute the unmodified official BHPT Mathematica dependency implementation and record version,inputs,outputs. taxonomy.original_author_input_propagation: Original author output is passed through a shared local downstream implementation and compared to local input propagated identically. This validates bounded input sensitivity, not the original author downstream implementation.
